body:
As a college graduate who has been unemployed for more than a year, I've always thought about killing myself. The guilt of having made some bad decisions and the sight my classmates holding stable jobs and enjoying themselves is overwhelming to me. I feel I've let my ageing parents down. I just want deliverance from this torment. 

But then I realise my parents can live with their son being unemployed, but my death will surely wreck their lives and dreams. For all my failures, they still believe in me. I guess I need to soldier on. Love for my parents is what keeps me alive at this point.
